{'text': 'Apple今日宣布將於下星期三10月28日（香港時間星期四凌晨）舉行本月的第二場活動。此次活動的主題標語為：「Pro and tell」（直譯：專業開講）。以下是預計將會發布的內容。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple today announced its second experience of the month, taking place next Wednesday, October 28 at 10 a.m. PT. The tagline for this event is: “Pro and tell.” Here’s what to expect.'}

{'text': '這是Apple本月的第二場活動，緊接在10月13日於紐約市舉行的「Welcome home」（歡迎回家）產品發布會。該場活動首次亮相了全新的HomeView智能顯示器、HomePod mini 2，以及新款Apple TV 4K。', 'paragraph_context': 'This marks Apple’s second event of the month, following the “Welcome home” product launch on October 13 in New York City. That event included the debut of the new HomeView smart display, the HomePod mini 2, and a new Apple TV 4K.'}

{'text': 'Apple的10月28日活動將於洛杉磯舉行。你可以在上方看到邀請函的設計圖，該邀請函已發送給傳媒成員，並由Greg Joswiak在社交媒體上發布。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple’s October 28 event will take place in Los Angeles. You can see the invite artwork above, which was sent to members of the press and posted on social media by Greg Joswiak.'}

{'text': '傳聞指Apple在下一場活動中有大量新產品準備發布，當中最受矚目的是首款配備觸控屏幕及OLED的MacBook Pro。根據彭博社的Mark Gurman，以下是預計發布的產品陣容：', 'paragraph_context': 'Rumors say Apple has a slew of new products to announce at its next event, headlined by its first MacBook Pro with a touchscreen and OLED. According to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, here’s what’s on the docket:'}

  • {'text': '全新的14吋及16吋配備觸控屏幕及OLED顯示器的MacBook Pro型號。兩款機型將首次加入Dynamic Island（動態島）功能，並且會比現有型號「明顯更輕」。新款MacBook Pro預計將搭載M5 Pro及M5 Max晶片。', 'paragraph_context': 'New 14-inch and 16-inch touchscreen MacBook Pro models with OLED displays. They will also have a Dynamic Island for the first time and will be “significantly lighter” than the current models. The new MacBook Pro models are expected to be powered by the M5 Pro and M5 Max chips.'}
  • {'text': '改版的iPad mini，配備OLED屏幕、「重新設計的揚聲器系統」，以及位置經過調整的FaceTime鏡頭', 'paragraph_context': 'A revamped iPad mini with an OLED screen, a “revamped speaker system,” and a relocated FaceTime camera'}
  • {'text': '搭載M6晶片的新款iMac及入門級14吋MacBook Pro，外觀將「與現有型號大致相同」。', 'paragraph_context': 'New iMac and entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro models powered by the M6 chip, which will “look like their current versions.”'}

{'text': '你最期待在Apple 10月28日的活動上見到哪些新產品？你有打算購買嗎？歡迎在留言區告訴我們。', 'paragraph_context': 'What are you most excited to see at Apple’s October 28 event? Are you planning to buy anything? Let us know down in the comments.'}

{'text': 'Chance的心水推介：', 'paragraph_context': 'Chance’s favorites:'}

  • {'text': 'Twelve South Airfly Drive：為任何汽車帶來無線CarPlay功能', 'paragraph_context': 'Twelve South Airfly Drive: Bring wireless CarPlay to any car'}
  • {'text': 'AirPods Pro 3：199美元（原價249美元）', 'paragraph_context': 'AirPods Pro 3: $199 (Reg. $249)'}
  • {'text': 'Logitech MX Master 4', 'paragraph_context': 'Logitech MX Master 4'}
  • {'text': 'Belkin 3合1 MagSafe充電器', 'paragraph_context': 'Belkin 3-in-1 MagSafe Charger'}
  • {'text': 'Beats編織USB-C充電線', 'paragraph_context': 'Beats Woven USB-C Charging Cables'}
  • {'text': 'Twelve South Butterfly 2合1充電器', 'paragraph_context': 'Twelve South Butterfly 2-in-1 Charger'}
